title: 第一卷第11章 聚宝斋第一卷第12章 青铜贵宾
content_zh:
;;
面对血淋淋的火焰蟒头，中年管事迟迟下不了嘴。
大厅内，一群群的赏金猎人都看着，表情惊愕。
君无邪这个愣头青，居然真的要管事吃蟒头，这是要把人往死里得罪啊。
猎人公会虽然对外宣称自己不属于势力，而是一个组织，但谁都清楚，他们的实力强到难以想象。
青阳城看似由城主府与四大家族掌控，可事实上三大商行与猎人公会这样的存在才是真正的霸主。
这样的公会，在每个城池都有，而青阳城的只是其万千分会中最弱小的一批分会中的一个罢了。
秦可清看到管事不动，眼神不禁又冷了几分。
管事吓得一哆嗦，将心一横，抱着蟒头啃了起来。
嘣的一声。
管事的牙齿当场崩断，满嘴鲜血，痛得他面部抽搐，腥臭味熏得他一阵狂呕，胆汁都快吐出来了。
君无邪斜睨他，道：“我说，你肾虚吧。正直壮年，牙口这么差？”
中年管事气得浑身发抖，要不是秦可清在这里，他想直接将这可恶的小子当场击杀，以出这口恶气！
君无邪好整以暇地看着他，硬是等他满口牙全都崩断了，蹲在地上吐了一地的胆汁才作罢。
“秦小姐，我妹妹还好吧？”
他也不再理会管事了，将蟒头拿到任务交接区交了任务，得到一张余额十万的金币卡，回到秦可清的面前。
“目前尚好。你妹妹很乖，只是她的身体有些虚弱。”
“我知道的。”
君无邪心酸，这半年，小月瑶很辛苦，还总是吃不饱，身体又怎么会不虚弱呢。
他跟随秦可清来到了一间环境不错的屋子里。

“无邪哥哥～”
小月瑶飞奔而来，乳燕投怀般扑到了他的怀里。
“多谢秦小姐这两天照顾月瑶。”
君无邪抚摸着她的小脑袋，她的眼里有泪光，想来这两天，小丫头肯定担心坏了。
“不用谢，举手之劳罢了。”秦可清将一块猎人令递给他，道：“恭喜你完成五星级悬赏任务，荣升四级猎人，往后可以接取隐藏悬赏任务。”
“什么是隐藏悬赏任务？”
君无邪微微一怔，他还是首次听说。
“我们猎人公会，出于客户的要求，有些任务是不会公开发布的，这类任务报酬更为丰富。你现在是四级猎人，凡是这块猎人令可以查询到的隐藏任务，你都可以接取。”
“意思就是，隐藏任务不用到猎人公会，直接在这块令牌上接取就可以了吗？”
“是的，你只需要将真气或者血气注入猎人令就能激活它的功能，可以查看或者接取任务。”
“明白了。”
君无邪点了点头。
“听说你跟萧家的萧旭有些矛盾，如今青阳城很多人都在讨论萧家的事情，说那萧旭已突破到了先天境五变。”
君无邪眼角一跳。
萧旭的境界怎么会突破得如此之快，前些天才刚沟通本命星辰，这一下就到了先天境五变？
“萧旭融合天命灵脉，应该是灵脉内的灵气让他境界飙升，其境界极有可能还会在短时间内继续飙升。”
“我知道了，谢谢秦小姐。”
君无邪道谢后，准备带月瑶离开。
“你们现在也没有去处，与其住客栈，还不如暂时就住在这里。”
秦可清说道。
content_en:

Facing the bloody flaming python head, the middle-aged steward couldn't bring himself to speak.
In the hall, groups of bounty hunters looked on with astonished expressions.
Jun Wuxie, a stupid young man, actually wants to take charge of things and eat python heads. This is to offend people to death.
Although the Hunter Guild claims to the outside world that it is not a force but an organization, everyone knows that their strength is unimaginable.
Qingyang City seems to be controlled by the City Lord's Palace and the four major families, but in fact, the three major trading houses and the Hunter Guild are the real overlords.
There are such guilds in every city, and the one in Qingyang City is just one of the weakest among its thousands of branches.
Qin Keqing's eyes couldn't help but become colder when he saw that the steward was motionless.
The steward shivered with fright, and with a sudden heart, he hugged the python head and began to chew on it.
Boom.
The steward's teeth were broken on the spot, and his mouth was filled with blood. The pain made his face twitch, and the fishy smell made him vomit violently, almost vomiting out bile.
Jun Wuxie glanced at him sideways and said, "I said, you must have a weak kidney. You are an upright man, but your teeth are so bad?"
The middle-aged steward was so angry that he was shaking all over. If Qin Keqing hadn't been here, he would have wanted to kill this hateful boy on the spot to vent his anger!
Jun Wuxie looked at him leisurely and waited until all his teeth broke and he squatted on the ground and vomited bile all over the floor.
"Miss Qin, is my sister okay?"
He stopped paying attention to the manager, took the python head to the task handover area, handed in the task, got a gold coin card with a balance of 100,000, and returned to Qin Keqing.
"She's fine so far. Your sister is very well-behaved, but her body is a little weak."
"I know."
Jun Wuxie felt sad. In the past six months, Xiao Yueyao had been very hard and she couldn't always eat enough. How could she not be weak?
He followed Qin Keqing to a room with a nice environment.
"Brother Wuxie~"
Xiao Yueyao rushed over, and the milk swallow threw herself into his arms.
"Thank you, Miss Qin, for taking care of Yueyao these two days."
Jun Wuxie stroked her little head, and there were tears in her eyes. Thinking about it, the little girl must have been worried in the past two days.
"You're welcome, it's just a piece of cake." Qin Keqing handed him a hunter's order and said, "Congratulations on completing the five-star bounty mission and being promoted to level four hunter. You can take on hidden bounty missions in the future."
"What is a hidden bounty mission?"
Jun Wuxie was slightly startled. This was the first time he heard about it.
"In our Hunter Guild, due to customer requirements, some tasks will not be released publicly. The rewards for such tasks are richer. You are now a level four hunter. You can accept any hidden tasks that can be found in this hunter order."
"Does this mean that you don't need to go to the Hunter's Guild to receive the hidden mission? You can just pick it up directly on this token?"
"Yes, you only need to inject true energy or blood into the Hunter Order to activate its functions, and you can view or accept tasks."
"Got it."
Jun Wuxie nodded.
"I heard that you have some conflicts with Xiao Xu of the Xiao family. Nowadays, many people in Qingyang City are discussing the affairs of the Xiao family, saying that Xiao Xu has broken through to the fifth transformation of the innate realm."
Jun Wuxie's eyes twitched.
How could Xiao Xu's realm break through so quickly? He had just communicated with his natal stars a few days ago, and now he had reached the fifth level of the innate realm?
"Xiao Xu's fusion of the destiny spiritual veins should be the spiritual energy in the spiritual veins that makes his realm soar. It is very likely that his realm will continue to soar in a short period of time."
"I understand, thank you Miss Qin."
After Jun Wuxie thanked him, he prepared to take Yueyao away.
"You have nowhere to go now. Instead of staying in an inn, it's better to stay here for the time being."
Qin Keqing said.
